I'm a big believer in a clutter free work environment so I only have what I NEED. So: 
1. 27in monitor 2. MBP stand for my laptop which I use as a second screen 3. Matias mechanical keyboard 4. Wireless mouse + mousepad 5. Coffee mug Occasionally I pull out a notepad, but I've found that using the Notes app on my laptop works better for me.
